content: प्रति(ती)हारः .²1 Striking back. .²2 A door, gate. .²3 A porter, door-keeper; आर्य अदेशकालः प्रतीहारस्य <ls>Svapna. 5</ls>, <ls n="Svapna.">6</ls>. .²4 A juggler. .²5 Juggling, a juggling trick. .²6 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The hard contact of the tongue with the edge of the teeth in pronouncing dental letters. .²7 Intimating arrival (आगमननिवेदन); संप्राप्यैते महात्मानो राघवस्य निवेशनम् . विष्ठिताः प्रतिहारार्थम् <ls>Rām. 7. 1. 7</ls>; see प्रतिहारण. .{@-री@} A female doorkeeper.
